subject: Megaton Hammer
text: The Megaton Hammer can be used to destroy unbombable boulders or push down rusted switches.

evidence.quote:
The secret item this time is the Megaton Hammer, which is used to 
destroy unbombable boulders or push down rusted switches.

subject: Flare Dancer
text: Defeat the mini-boss by hookshotting the black ball and then slicing the ball with the sword.

evidence.quote:
To defeat the mini-
boss, just hookshot the black ball, then slice up the ball with your sword.

subject: Volvagia
text: When Volvagia's head pops out of the lava, pound it once with the Megaton Hammer to stun it, and pound it again to damage it.

evidence.quote:
The boss, Volvagia, is fairly simple: wait for his head to pop up out of the
lava, pound it once with the Megaton Hammer to stun it, then pound it again to
damage it.

subject: Chest
text: A chest in the cell on the left contains a key obtained after pressing the switch to free the Goron.

evidence.quote:
Jump over to the cell on the left, press the switch to free the Goron, and
  get the key from the chest.

subject: Chest
text: A chest behind a fake wall on the right ledge contains a key obtained after freeing the Goron.

evidence.quote:
Jump to the right side of this room, bomb the fake wall on the ledge and go
  through.
- Free the Goron and get the key from the chest.

subject: Goron
text: Freeing the Goron on the left side of the big room rewards a key.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the big room, then go to the left side and go through that door.
- Free the Goron and get the key, then go back to the big room.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found inside the top door on the left side, reached by playing the Song of Time below the blue block.

evidence.quote:
Play the Song of Time below the blue block, then hop up to the top door on
  the left side and go through.
- Kill the Gold Skulltula (#1) inside, then come back out.

subject: Gorons
text: Freeing the two trapped Gorons in this room yields two keys.

evidence.quote:
There are two trapped Gorons here: one through a door and the other in the
  room itself; free both of them and get the two keys.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is revealed by bombing the wall at the point where it can be heard.

evidence.quote:
Along one of the walls in this room you will hear a Gold Skulltula (#2)- 
  bomb the wall at that point to find it.

subject: Chest
text: A chest through the east door after shooting an eye switch contains the dungeon map.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the eye with an arrow and go through the east door, and get the map
  from the chest.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located up grated walls after playing the Scarecrow's song and hookshotting to the scarecrow and targeted platform.

evidence.quote:
Play the Scarecrow's song when you enter, hookshot up to it, then hookshot 
  to the targeted platform and ride it up.
- Go through and up the grated walls to reach a Gold Skulltula (#3).

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the wall in the room continuing up the grated wall.

evidence.quote:
Continue up the wall, to the next room.
- Shoot the Gold Skulltula on the wall (#4) and get the token.

subject: Goron
text: Dropping down through the cracked floor after bombing it in the boulder room leads to a Goron who gives a key when freed.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the top floor of the boulder room, jump across and bomb the 
  cracked floor, then drop down.
- Free the Goron and get the key, then go back and climb back up.

subject: Chest
text: A chest inside a cell contains a key after pressing the switch on the ledge to free the Goron.

evidence.quote:
Jump over to the ledge with the switch to free the Goron, then jump over to
  its cell and get the key from the chest.

subject: Chest
text: A chest in the door on the right-hand wall contains the compass.

evidence.quote:
Turn right and go through the door on the right-hand wall.
- Get the compass from the chest, then go back to the previous room.

subject: Chest
text: A chest on the inside ledge reached after stepping on the switch contains the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote:
Step on the switch, then run around the inside ledge to the chest and get 
  the Megaton Hammer from it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is on the wall in the room beyond the enemies behind the entrance room's right door.

evidence.quote:
Kill the enemies and go to the next room.
- Kill the Gold Skulltula (#5) on the wall and go to the next room.

subject: Chest
text: A chest beyond the mini-boss contains the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Kill the mini-boss, go through the next door and get the Boss Key from the
  chest.

subject: Great Fairy
text: The Great Fairy inside the tunnel blocked by boulders across two bridges gives Link the Double Magic meter.

evidence.quote:
From where you leave the temple, turn left and hookshot across the bridge.  Go
left across the next bridge and pound the boulders in front of the tunnel.  Go
inside and the Great Fairy will give you the Double Magic meter.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is hidden under a boulder that must be bashed with the hammer in the falling boulder valley near the peak of Death Mountain.

evidence.quote:
Approach the peak of Death Mountain to the valley with falling boulders.  One
of the boulders here is covering another Gold Skulltula.  Bash it with the 
hammer.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is covered by a boulder outside Goron City's top exit, through the short tunnel above the Dodongo's Cavern entrance.

evidence.quote:
Head back to Goron City, then leave the city through the top exit.  Go forward 
and then right through the short tunnel above the Dodongo's Cavern entrance 
(where you threw a bomb to open up the entrance as a kid).  Pound the nearby 
boulder with the hammer and kill the Gold Skulltula it was covering.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is on a wall inside a grotto near the entrance to Gerudo Valley, found by pounding a boulder, bombing the stone circle, and burning webs with Din's Fire.

evidence.quote:
Go to the entrance to Gerudo Valley in Hyrule Field.  Pound the nearby boulder
surrounded by small rocks, then bomb the circle and fall through the hole.  
Use Din's Fire to destroy the webs and get the Gold Skulltula on a wall.

subject: Water Temple Entrance
text: Hookshotting the diamond object over the Water Temple entrance opens it up.

evidence.quote:
Hookshot the 
diamond object over the entrance, and it will open up for you.

subject: Water Level Stations
text: The first station lowers water to the bottom, the station in the middle column raises water to the middle, and the second-floor west door station raises water to the top.

evidence.quote:
The first station
you find lowers the water level to the bottom.  The station in the middle 
column of the big room raises the water level to the middle.  The station 
accessible from the west door of the second floor raises the water level to
the top.

subject: Dark Link
text: The mini-boss Dark Link guards the dungeon item and can be easily defeated with the sword.

evidence.quote:
The mini-boss guarding the dungeon item is Dark Link, and he is easily
defeatable with the sword.

subject: Morpha
text: To defeat Morpha, stand on the edges, target the pink orb, avoid the water arm, hookshot the orb, and slice it with the sword.

evidence.quote:
To defeat the boss, Morpha, stand on the
edges and target the pink orb, avoid the arm that thrusts out of the water
and hookshot the orb, then slice it with your sword.

subject: Chest
text: A chest on the top floor through the door past Ruto contains the map.

evidence.quote:
Float up to the top floor and go through the door.
- Get the map from the chest.

subject: Chest
text: A chest through the door unlocked by lighting torches with Din's Fire at the bottom of the room contains a key.

evidence.quote:
Drop all the way down, light the torches with Din's Fire, and go through
  the unlocked door.
- Get the key from the chest, then go back to the big room.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found behind a cage by raising the stairs and spin attacking the crystal.

evidence.quote:
Step on the switch to raise the stairs, then spin attack the crystal behind
  the cage and kill the Gold Skulltula (#1) behind it.

subject: Chest
text: A chest in the room accessed by sinking onto the pipe, shooting the crystal, and hookshotting to the target contains a key.

evidence.quote:
Sink down onto the pipe in the water, shoot the crystal, hookshot to the
  target, get past the gate and float up to the next room.
- Get the key from the chest, then go back to the big room.

subject: Chest
text: A chest beneath the central column block contains a key after hitting the crystal and killing enemies to open the gate.

evidence.quote:
Sink back down to the bottom and drop down the hole the block was covering.
- Hit the crystal and kill the enemies to open up the gate.
- Float up and get the key from the chest, then go back to the big room.

subject: Chest
text: A chest behind a bombed wall through the bottom floor's east doorway contains a key.

evidence.quote:
Sink down and go through the east doorway on the bottom floor.
- Float up and bomb the wall, get the key from the chest, and go back to the
  big room.

subject: Chest
text: A chest on the second floor east room contains the compass after hookshotting to the ceiling and hitting the crystal.

evidence.quote:
Float up to the east doorway on the second floor and go through.
- Hookshot up to the ceiling, hit the crystal and get the compass from the 
  chest.

subject: Chest
text: A chest in the room beyond the mini-boss contains the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Kill the mini-boss, go to the next room and get the Longshot from the chest.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula token is obtained using Iron Boots on the wall after swimming across the rapids past the Song of Time blue block.

evidence.quote:
Swim across the rapids, then use the Iron Boots nearby the Gold Skulltula
  (#2) on the wall and get its token.

subject: Chest
text: A chest reached by shooting an eye and hookshotting to it contains a key.

evidence.quote:
Swim to the platform across from the pots, shoot the eye, hookshot to the
  chest and get the key.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula token is collected with the Longshot near the ceiling of the center column.

evidence.quote:
Hookshot up to the ceiling in the center column, kill the Gold Skulltula 
  (#3) and get the token with the Longshot.

subject: Chest
text: A chest through the passage on the second floor reached by shooting the gold eye to the south contains a key.

evidence.quote:
In the second floor of the big room, shoot the gold eye to the south, then
  hookshot across past the closing gate.
- Go through the passage, push the block, and get the key from the chest.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located behind the waterfall beyond the room with the block pushed onto a switch.

evidence.quote:
Step on the switch and jump over to the next room.
- Shoot the Gold Skulltula (#4) behind the waterfall and get the token.

subject: Chest
text: A chest through the locked door below the falling boulders contains the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Sink down the hole where the boulders drop down to the next room.
- Go through the locked door, then get the Boss Key from the chest.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is on the wall in the moving platform room through the west door when the water is at the highest level.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the big room and raise the water to the highest level.
- Go back through the west door to the moving platform room, shoot the Gold 
  Skulltula (#5) on the wall and get the token with the Longshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is at the top of a tree near the Water Temple exit, killable at night with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
From where you exit the dungeon, use the Longshot to get to the top of the 
nearby tree at night, and kill the Gold Skulltula there.

subject: Fire Arrows
text: Shooting an arrow at the morning sun while standing on the brown pedestal drops Fire Arrows into Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote:
Stand on the brown pedestal on this island in the lake, and wait for the
morning sun to rise.  Shoot an arrow at the sun at that moment, and the Fire
Arrows will drop down and you can swim across to get them.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is on the wall near the bridge at the end of Zora's River, retrievable with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Head back to Zora's River and go all the way across the bridge near the end.
Near the bridge, look up and kill the Skulltula on the wall, and get the
token with the Longshot.

subject: Chest
text: A chest on one of the roofs on top of Gerudo Fortress contains a Heart Piece reached via Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Enter the thieves' hideout in Gerudo Fortress once again, and get to the top
of the outside of the fortress.  Longshot over to the chest on one of the 
roofs and get the Heart Piece from it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is on the big target to the north of the archery game at Gerudo Fortress.

evidence.quote:
Go over to the archery game at the fortress.  There is a Gold Skulltula on
the big target all the way to the north- use the Longshot to get the token.

subject: Nocturne of Shadow
text: Sheik teaches the Nocturne of Shadow in Kakariko Village after completing the Water Temple.

evidence.quote:
Return to Kakariko Village after beating the Water Temple, and Sheik will
teach you this song after the cutscene.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the wall on top of the roof of Impa's house in southern Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Use the Longshot to get on the roof of Impa's house, in the south section of
the village.  The Gold Skulltula is on the wall up there.

subject: Man on the Roof
text: The man sitting on the roof of a house in Kakariko Village gives Link a Heart Piece when reached with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Longshot over to the man sitting on the roof of one of the houses in the 
village, and he will give you a Heart Piece.

subject: Dampe's Ghost Race
text: Racing Dampe's Spirit in the Graveyard and using the Longshot to cross the long gap to finish in under a minute rewards a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Enter the graveyard and race Dampe's Spirit again inside one of the headstone
holes.  At the end, use the Longshot to get across the long gap and reach the
finish in under a minute to get a Heart Piece.
